Serum iron (Fe)
Serum Fe31 reduced to Fe21 and 
then complexed with chromogen.
Slightly higher in males than in  
premenopausal females; reflects 
recent Fe intake.
F: 40-150 mcg/dL 
(7.2-26.9 mmol/L)
M: 50-160 mg/dL 
(8.9-28.7 mmol/L)
Very insensitive index of total Fe 
stores; extremely variable  
(day-to-day and diurnal).
Total Iron  
Binding  
Capacity 
(TIBC)
TIBC determined by saturating  
serum transferrin with Fe and 
then remeasuring serum Fe.
Reflects transferrin concentration.
250-400 mcg/dL  
(45-71 mmol/L)
TIBC does not increase until Fe 
stores are essentially completely 
depleted. TIBC decreases with 
increased Fe stores; used to 
rule out excess iron intake or he-
mochromatosis. See Chapter 32
